items.title: KPop Demon Hunters 2 Gets a Theatrical Release After First Movie's Smashing Success on Streaming
items.excerpt: The KPop Demon Hunters sequel won’t be repeating the mistakes of its predecessor, having secured a guaranteed theatrical release following the first film’s smashing success.
items.content_text: The KPop Demon Hunters sequel won’t be repeating the mistakes of its predecessor, having secured a guaranteed theatrical release following the first film’s smashing success. The news was casually and somewhat unceremoniously buried in an October 20 report from The Hollywood Reporter , which dove into the events behind the departure of Netflix’s former film chief, Dan Lin. According to THR, Lin helped secure a theatrical release for KPop Demon Hunters 2, a move that the outlet noted “hasn’t been officially announced.” News of a sequel — er, more like sequels — was revealed in November 2025 when Variety reported that Netflix and Sony had inked a deal for a second animated film, with a release date planned for 2029 . Around that same time, The Wrap revealed what’s next for the KPop Demon Hunters universe, including plans for a live-action movie, a stage play and two sequels to create a film trilogy. A spinoff series and short film were also mentioned, though none of these particular projects have been officially announced by the streamer. Co-director Maggie Kang has already set expectations high for more stories from Huntrix in their quest to protect the Honmoon. “We’ve set up so much for potential backstory,” she told Variety in a July interview. “Obviously, there’s a lot of questions that are left unanswered and areas that are not explored. We had to do that because there’s only so much movie you could tell in 85 minutes.” KPop Demon Hunters became Netflix’s most-watched offering ever, outperforming live-action films and TV series alike. It spawned oodles of Halloween costumes, sing-along versions of the movie, and oodles of live performances from the film’s singers, EJAE, Rei Ami, and Audrey Nuna ( at the Oscars, no less! ). The franchise went on to snag collaborations with McDonald’s , Fortnite , and even LEGO , among many others. Given its huge success, it comes as little surprise that Netflix is taking notes from the first film and rolling out the red carpet for its next installment. And considering the popularity of its limited-time theatrical screenings once Netflix took note of its success, it's safe to say that it won't pass up the bag this time around. Dan Lin was a huge proponent of theatrical releases for Netflix’s films, according to THR’s report. While Co-CEO Ted Sarandos preferred the pandemic-era strategy of going straight to streaming, Lin picked up on the increasing demand for theatrical experiences from younger moviegoers — a footprint he left at the company before his recent exit. In related news, Derpy the tiger recently scored a 37,000-Piece Kpop Demon Hunters Build with LEGO — a far funner story than a Christian metal band called Demon Hunter that sued Netflix over copyright infringement earlier this year. (Netflix dismissed these claims, saying the “allegations are without merit” in an official statement.)
items.title_en: KPop Demon Hunters 2 Gets a Theatrical Release After First Movie's Smashing Success on Streaming

items.title: The Chronicles of Narnia Books are on Sale at Amazon, Including a Deluxe Edition Hardcover
items.content_text: Amazon is currently running a buy 1, get 1 50% off sale on all of the Narnia books this week. The promotion extends to hardcovers, box sets, paperbacks, and even a massive 7-in-1 deluxe edition. With Greta Gerwig's upcoming Narnia movie hitting theaters early next year, this discount is a great time to read the original C.S. Lewis novels that inspired it all. If you're only looking to read the source material for Gerwig's movie, you'll want to check out the deal on The Magician's Nephew first. The paperback, hardcover, and collector's edition are included in the sale. You can also get a copy of it in the box set or deluxe edition available here if you want the full collection instead. Buy 1, Get 1 Half Off Narnia Book Sale at Amazon Amazon has these types of sales pretty regularly and now is a particularly good time to buy multiple books at once . All you need to do is add two eligible books to your cart and Amazon will automatically apply the 50% discount to whichever one is the cheapest. This means you'll want to buy two similarly priced books to take full advantage of the discount. So, for example, if you're looking to buy the deluxe edition at $39.50, you probably don't want to also buy The Magician's Nephew paperback for $7 at the same time. Instead you'll want to browse the sale for something closer to $40 to maximize your savings. Because of that, this sale usually works best if you're looking to get multiple copies of the same book at the same price point. Where Is The Magician's Nephew on the Book Timeline? If you're new to The Chronicles of Narnia books , it's worth noting that the official reading order is up for debate. If you're looking to read the story in terms of when the events take place chronologically, The Magician's Nephew would count as book one in the series. But it was actually the fifth book C.S. Lewis published. The box set and the deluxe edition both place The Magician's Nephew as the first book, but it may not be the order you'll want to read it in. The actual order in which you read the books doesn't really matter, and C.S. Lewis has said as much . But if you're a purist who would rather read the books in the way Lewis intended his audience to read them at the time, you'll want to start with The Lion, The Witch, and The Wardrobe instead. When Is the New Chronicles of Narnia Movie Coming Out? It's been in the works for a while, but Greta Gerwig's Narnia movie is coming to theaters pretty soon. It's theatrical debut is set for February 12, 2027 and it will eventually come directly to Netflix in April 2027. So if you want to read the book before seeing the movie, you've still got some time to do so.

items.title: GTA 6 Fans Think Rockstar Games Is Shooting an Elaborate and Expensive Live-Action Trailer in Miami
items.excerpt: Eagle-eyed Rockstar fans have noticed camera crews recording convoys of flashy GTA-themed cars in Miami, creating speculation over a new live-action trailer.
items.content_text: Eagle-eyed Rockstar fans have noticed camera crews recording convoys of flashy GTA 6 -themed cars in Miami, creating speculation over a new live-action trailer. Rockstar Games has been conquering the city of Miami over the last few weeks as it ramps up to the release of GTA 6, which is set in a fictional version of Miami called Vice City. As a result, Rockstar has plastered all kinds of ads around the area, sent in a Vice City blimp to fly over Florida, and announced unique celebrations like a Vice City-themed NBA game with the Miami Heat in November. It's an unprecedented marketing campaign that has quite literally turned the city into a real-life version of GTA's universe. With that said, there appear to be a variety of things happening right under Miamians' noses without much explanation. Fans have started noticing exotic sports cars driving around the city in convoys, sometimes joined by a camera crew. These aren't just ordinary cars, as they're modified to resemble ones from the GTA series. In some videos and photos posted by fans, you can see in-universe car brands such as Grotti (a parody of Ferrari) and Emerus (a parody of McLaren) on some of the vehicles that are zooming around. Filming of a separate video or trailer for GTA VI continues in Miami🌴 #GTAVI #GTA6 https://t.co/YSbI11vvmu — GTA 6 Raf (@GTAVI_Rodion) October 20, 2026 Rockstar Games and West Coast Customs popped out in Key Biscayne today to do some promo for GTA 6 🔥 https://t.co/hhRg2OP8i6 — Uncle Ken (@Tallglassofwada) October 15, 2026 Got pictures and several videos of the GTA 6 cars driving around Miami! Absolutely insane! 🔥 https://t.co/765ef66NaW — real.saem | Samchrme (@samchrme) October 20, 2026 There is a widespread belief online that Rockstar intentionally released the latest trailer significantly earlier in order to release another GTA 6 video, filmed in real life, before the game's launch. Over the past two days, high activity has been observed in Miami: camera operators are working there, and GTA 6 advertisements have been placed. For example, there are graffiti pieces that do not mention GTA 6 but simply read "Vice City." The same inscription, "Welcome to Vice City," is also present on the stadium. Presumably, all of this was done not only as part of a PR campaign but also to film the main trailer against a backdrop of streets that will be identical to the locations in GTA 6: the same advertising billboards, graffiti, and cars with similar license plates. It is quite possible that we will see such a video on the day the game becomes available for pre-installation. #GTAVI #GTA6 — GTA 6 Raf (@GTAVI_Rodion) October 20, 2026 Some fans speculate that Rockstar is shooting a live-action GTA 6 trailer and will utilize some of the real ads around the city to highlight the fact it has created a real-life version of Vice City. As of right now, Rockstar hasn't addressed any of this advertising, and has instead let it speak for itself. Similarly, there have been reports that Rockstar will be releasing real-life versions of GTA beer brands in the near future following listings on a government database. It's anyone's guess what all of this is being used for, but all signs seem to point to it being related to GTA. Rockstar has already announced that its Miami Heat sponsored game will be called "A Night in Vice City," so maybe there are plans for more activities around the entire city beyond the actual basketball game. Either way, this is some next-level marketing and shows Rockstar is sparing no expense. GTA 6 will release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Pro Aleksib Faces Four-Month Suspended Prison Sentence Over Charges of Aggravated Tax Fraud
items.excerpt: Finnish Counter-Strike 2 pro Aleksi “Aleksib” Virolainen is facing a possible four-month suspended prison sentence over alleged “aggravated tax fraud” after failing to declare income from in-game sticker sales.
items.content_text: Finnish Counter-Strike 2 pro Aleksi “Aleksib” Virolainen is facing a possible four-month suspended prison sentence over alleged “aggravated tax fraud” after failing to declare income from in-game sticker sales. In Counter-Strike 2 , players can purchase virtual stickers and place them on their weapons. They are an in-game item that can be bought on the Steam Marketplace, the CS2 Store, or in capsules, as well as through third-party websites. It’s not uncommon for professional teams to get a cut of the money earned from sticker sales and other in-game purchases when they compete at major tournaments — and it’s this revenue that prosecutors say Virolainen failed to include on his tax forms. On Friday, October 16, an indictment was read aloud at the Eastern Uusimaa District Court that accused the pro player of failing to declare €53,000 in income (about $59,553.18 USD) from Valve in 2020, the developer of Counter-Strike 2. Prosecutors claimed that he was able to avoid paying an estimated €28,000 ($31,441 USD) in taxes as a result — but he said he wasn’t aware that this income needed to be declared. While Virolainen admitted that he failed to declare these earnings, he said that he was just 22 years old at the time with no real understanding of how the tax system worked. The Defense maintained that he was under the impression that his taxes had been fully handled, since taxes had already been taken out of his general income, and that he did not seek any financial gain from failing to report them. As reported by Finnish news outlet Iltalehti , the alleged offense took place between May 19, 2020 and September 22, 2020 in Vantaa, Finland. A subpoena stated that the player did not return a pre-filled tax return form for the 2019 year and did not report any missing income from Valve. Prosecutors are demanding that he serve a four-month suspended prison sentence for the alleged offense. Viorlainen has not been formally convicted of the supposed crime, and a district court is set to issue a ruling on the case at a later date. A tweet containing footage of the pro player arriving at court went viral within the CS2 community, showing him sitting down in the courtroom as cameras flashed in the background. Virolainen reportedly pleaded not guilty to the charges. The now-29-year-old Aleksib is still an active player, currently representing Natus Vincere. As pointed out by Dexerto , he competed at two Majors with ENCE during the time of the supposed tax fraud, with his most notable finish happening at the IEM Katowice 2019 Major, where his team reached the Grand Finals. items.title: Mel Brooks Insisted on Shooting His Scenes for Spaceballs: The New One Before the Rest of the Cast
items.excerpt: Mel Brooks, the centenarian comedy legend who directed the original Spaceballs, arranged to have his scenes for Spaceballs: The New One shot first to ensure his character Yogurt made it into the movie lest he pass away during production.
items.content_text: Mel Brooks, the centenarian comedy legend who directed the original Spaceballs , arranged to have his scenes for Spaceballs: The New One shot first to ensure his character Yogurt made it into the movie lest he pass away during production. “We filmed Spaceballs: The New One that Mel Brooks worked with the writers on. He’s a big influence in it. He filmed his part already before we shot. It was his idea: ‘You better film me now because I’m 100.’ So we did,” actress Daphne Zuniga revealed at this past weekend’s 90s Con, according to People . Zuniga reprises her role as Vespa (now Queen) alongside Bill Pullman as Lone Starr. Lewis Pullman, Bill’s real-life son, plays their child, Prince Starburst. Rick Moranis also returns , reprising his role as Dark Helmet opposite George Wyner as his flunky, Colonel Sandurz. The sequel’s cast also includes Josh Gad (as Mawg), Keke Palmer (as Destiny), and Anthony Carrigan. The publicity campaign for the sequel has so far spoofed an 11-film slate for the Spaceballs Cinematic Universe , teased a now-digital Yogurt with ripped abs , and parodied The Force Awakens’ table read photo . Josh Greenbaum (Barb and Star Go to Vista Del Mar) is directing from a script by Benji Samit and Dan Hernandez (Lego Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy; TMNT: Mutant Mayhem), and Josh Gad. Amazon MGM Studios will release Spaceballs: The New One in 2027.

items.title: It Looks Like GTA 6's Beer Brands Are About to Become Real
items.excerpt: It appears that Rockstar may be preparing to sell beer brands from GTA 6 in real life.
items.content_text: It appears that Rockstar may be preparing to sell beer brands from GTA 6 in real life. As spotted by iGrandTheftAuto , labels for three GTA-related beer brands have been approved by the US Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau. The labels include brands that have been featured in previous GTA titles, such as Patriot Beer and Pißwasser (commonly known as Pisswasser). There's also a new brand known as No Mames Vice City, which features a little dog wearing sunglasses and a Vice City chain on the label. These are being produced by a Florida brewery known as Tripping Animals Brewing. For alcohol afficianados, No Mames Vice City lager will have a 6% ABV, while the other two will be 4.2% ABV, which is identical to Bud Light's ABV. With all of that said, we have no idea exactly when or where these beverages will be sold. They may be exclusive to bars in and around Miami, as Rockstar Games has completely taken over the city with GTA 6 ads . Citizens have spotted various in-universe ads for various GTA brands around the area, and there's also a giant Vice City blimp flying over Florida. The Miami Heat's arena has also been transformed ahead of an unprecedented Vice City-themed NBA game in November . It's possible some of these drinks could be sold online, but it may make more sense to keep it limited to special in-person activiations around the city. Either way, it shows that Rockstar has spared no expense when it comes to alerting the public of GTA 6's arrival. Rockstar has also begun advertising the game in Paris, New York City, Chicago, and Los Angeles. It's unclear if any other cities will get big advertising outside of posters and billboards, or if this is all exclusive to Miami itself. GTA 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5.

items.title: Greta Gerwig Reportedly Clashed With Netflix Film Boss Over Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew
items.excerpt: Barbie writer-director Greta Gerwig reportedly had a bitter falling out with Netflix’s then-head of film, Dan Lin, over her upcoming movie, Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew.
items.content_text: Barbie writer-director Greta Gerwig reportedly had a bitter falling out with Netflix’s then-head of film over her upcoming movie, Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew . In their rundown of why Netflix fired Dan Lin earlier this week, Variety claimed Lin had clashed with both Gerwig and Ben Affleck (who most recently directed Animals for the streamer) during his tenure as the streamer’s movies boss. “Four sources with knowledge of the matter said that, indeed, Lin and Gerwig had a falling out during a Zoom call about the project earlier this year. On a virtual meeting populated by numerous Netflix executives, Lin is said to have been ‘dismissive’ to the director in conversation about the progress of the film,” according to Variety. “Lin is known in town to be incredibly fair, but at times obtuse in his frankness. Word travelled fast around Netflix that the meeting had gone south, at which point sources said [then-chief content officer Bela] Bajaria called Gerwig’s producer Amy Pascal to smooth things over. Two sources also said that Gerwig’s new, all-powerful CAA agent Bryan Lourd went to Sarandos directly over the faux pas. Lin was subsequently disappeared from the film, all sources concurred, and [Lin’s top lieutenant Doug] Belgrad stepped in as the primary Netflix exec overseeing the project (until, of course, he was laid off last week).” “None of the sources suggested the incident led to Lin’s firing,” Variety added. Not long before his firing, Lin declared in an interview that Netflix “just won’t work with” directors who want their films to also be released in cinemas . “There is a group of filmmakers who still want theatrical," Lin said. "Those are filmmakers that we’ve accepted we just won’t work with." Netflix recently kicked off its marketing campaign for The Magician’s Nephew with the release of the first trailer and new poster for Gerwig’s film adaptation of C.S. Lewis’ 1955 fantasy novel. That trailer was enough to convince IGN’s Jesse Schedeen to stop being skeptical about the project’s very existence . Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew opens exclusively in theaters on February 12, 2027 (IMAX previews begin February 10) before streaming on Netflix on April 2. The film’s cast includes David McKenna, Beatrice Campbell, Emma Mackey, Carey Mulligan, Ciarán Hinds, with Daniel Craig and Meryl Streep , Kobna Holdbrook-Smith, Denise Gough, Susan Wokoma.

items.title: Police Confirm Nearly $1 Million Worth of Trading Cards Stolen in PSA FedEx Truck Heist
items.excerpt: Police in Santa Ana, California estimate that more than $963,000 in collectible trading cards was stolen from a FedEx truck outside of PSA’s Santa Ana headquarters.
items.content_text: Police in Santa Ana, California estimate that more than $963,000 in collectible trading cards was stolen from a FedEx truck outside of PSA’s Santa Ana headquarters. The theft went viral in mid-October after several card collectors reported that they had received emails from PSA (Professional Sports Authenticator) stating that a FedEx truck carrying their collections had been burglarized. One of the most prominent voices in this conversation was a collector by the screen name SKY-B, who claimed that more than $100,000 worth of cards that he’d hand-delivered to PSA at a card show for grading were now lost in the ether. "We will compensate you for the items from your order that were involved, which is based on fair market value up to the Maximum Insured Value ("MIV") you selected for each item." @natsturner, I pray you handle this and take care of everyone affected in the most professional manner possible. I have an awful feeling PSA is going to be extremely unfair on what the values of these cards are. — SKY-B (@SKYBCards) October 17, 2026 PSA responded to the situation in a statement to IGN , outlining their plans to refund the affected customers and cooperate with both FedEx and law enforcement to investigate the burglary. A day later, Santa Ana police have released a statement about the theft, as well as the eyewatering dollar amount that was stolen — and it’s far more than was originally calculated. The theft occurred on October 13 outside of PSA’s headquarters in Santa Ana, California when a FedEx driver reportedly left their truck parked nearby for around 60 to 90 minutes. The thieves were able to break the truck’s lock and make off with the packages stored inside during this time. According to police, two pallets holding an estimated 100 packages were stolen, as well as a third pallet carrying around 50 packages. Law enforcement officials estimate that the total dollar amount of the first two pallets adds up to around $963,000. No dollar amount has yet been calculated for the third pallet, but given what we already know, it’s looking likely that the total damage will ring up to more than $1 million. “The pallets contained various trading cards, including, but not limited to, sports cards and Pokémon cards,” the SAPD told The Athletic . “The exact value of the stolen items has not yet been determined, pending further investigation. The investigation remains ongoing. Anyone with information regarding this incident is encouraged to contact the Santa Ana Police Department.” FedEx also released a statement, saying “the security of our customers’ shipments is a top priority, and we are working with local law enforcement in their investigation.” PSA, for its part, has promised to refund customers “based on fair market value up to the Maximum Insured Value" of their cards and has deactivated the certificates of the stolen items. "We understand the impact this has on collectors involved, many of whom see these cards as far more than a financial asset. Our team is focused on supporting them. We take this incident seriously, and we will continue working with law enforcement to hold those responsible accountable,” it said. Image Credits: Marcin Golba/NurPhoto via Getty Images
items.title_en: Police Confirm Nearly $1 Million Worth of Trading Cards Stolen in PSA FedEx Truck Heist

items.title: Fight Night, EA's Beloved but Long-Dormant Boxing Sim Franchise, Is Coming Back
items.excerpt: Electronic Arts created social media accounts for its long-dormant boxing sim franchise Fight Night and the first post was exactly what fans wanted to hear: Fight Night is coming back.
items.content_text: Electronic Arts created social media accounts for its long-dormant boxing sim franchise Fight Night and the first post was exactly what fans wanted to hear: Fight Night is coming back. The full post reads, "To everyone who stayed in our corner: Fight Night is coming back." And there's an image of a pair of boxing gloves hanging over a boxing ring with the caption, "The fight is never over." There are no additional details as of now, such as who's developing the project (the original and most recent two were built by EA Canada in Vancouver, while Fight Night Round 2 and Round 3 were developed by the now-shuttered EA Chicago), whether it's even a new game at all or potentially a remaster or remake – which I find unlikely given all of the licensing involved in these games; odds are it's a new entry – or a release window. Or, heck, if it's even targeting the current generation of consoles. Regardless, the return of Fight Night should be welcome news to a lot of gamers, myself included. In the run-up to next month's 25th anniversary of Xbox, I've been writing a series of retrospective pieces about Xbox games I have fond memories of over the past quarter-century. One of those pieces was about Fight Night Round 3, which was, in my humble opinion, the first "holy sh*t!" game of the HD Era , graphically speaking. While Fight Night has been dormant, EA has shifted its resources to the UFC game franchise, whose most recent entry, UFC 6, was released earlier this year and our reviewer thought it was great .

items.title: New Star Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles Artwork Answers the Biggest Question About This Epic Crossover
items.excerpt: Marvel Comics has released a new preview for Star Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles, in the process answering the biggest burning question surrounding this unlikely crossover.
items.content_text: It's still hard to believe that Lucasfilm and Marvel Comics have actually done the unthinkable and greenlit a Star Wars/Marvel crossover . But that's exactly what we have to look forward to in January 2027, as Kevin Smith and David Marquez unite to give us Star Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles. Marvel just released a new preview of the first issue of the series, and in the process they've addressed what may well be the biggest question surrounding the series. Check out this new art in the slideshow gallery below, and then we'll break it all down: The burning mystery in question is whether the Marvel characters are aware of the existence of the Star Wars franchise in this story. After all, there's been a proud tradition of Marvel's heroes making tongue-in-cheek Star Wars references over the years, both in the comics and in the MCU. It would be a little weird if they suddenly behaved as if Star Wars isn't a thing in their home galaxy. As this art shows, they clearly are aware of Star Wars, with every hero but Captain America being intimately familiar with the movies. Somehow, Star Wars has gone from being a beloved fictional property to a flesh-and-blood reality for the Avengers, and they're clearly more than a little taken aback at being thrust into the opening scene of Episode IV. All of this suggests that Smith is taking a slightly more self-aware and fourth-wall-breaking approach to this particular crossover in his scripts. Are the lines between fiction and reality blurring together here, or will the series ultimately reveal that the Star Wars movies were always a true account of events that really did happen "a long time ago in a galaxy far, far away"? We'll find out in 2027. Other big crossovers revealed this year have included Judge Dredd/Biker Mice From Mars , G.I. Joe/Tomb Raider , and Batman/Superman/Weird Al: World's Weirdest. Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

items.content_text: Walmart is offering the best deal right now on an affordable 1080p-capable gaming PC. For a limited time, you can pick up a CyberPowerPC prebuilt gaming PC featuring the newest Intel Core Ultra 7 PLUS CPU and GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU for $1,249 with free shipping. It's much more powerful (and upgradeable) than the Steam Machine. CyberPowerPC RTX 5060 Ti Gaming PC for $1,249 The CyberPowerPC Gamer Supreme gaming PC is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus CPU, GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and 1TB NVMe SSD. The Intel Core Ultra 7 270K is part of Intel's newest Arrow Lake Refresh desktop CPUs released earlier this year. It features 24 cores and a maximum turbo frequency of 5.5GHz and excels at both gaming and productivity tasks. It's cooled by a 360mm liquid AIO. Expect to see at the bare minimum a 30%-40% performance advantage favoring the RTX 5060 Ti gaming rig. The CyberPowerPC is also much easier to upgrade in the future, since it uses non-proprietary off-the-shelf parts and a classic midtower PC design. items.title: Xbox Game Pass Reportedly Getting 'Major Overhaul,' Will Feature 'À La Carte' Options
items.excerpt: Microsoft is reportedly planning a substantial revamp of Xbox Game Pass that will allow subscribers to choose the features they want in an à la carte fashion. The report comes by way of a new Fortune profile piece on Xbox CEO Asha Sharma.
items.content_text: Microsoft is reportedly planning a substantial revamp of Xbox Game Pass that will allow subscribers to choose the features they want in an à la carte fashion. The report comes by way of a new Fortune profile piece on Xbox CEO Asha Sharma. "Xbox is planning a major overhaul of Game Pass that would have players choose features à la carte," Fortune wrote, "including add-ons for console-only games, cloud gaming, and multiplayer, with the system operating on a tiered structure, according to people familiar with the strategy." The piece dug in on Xbox's controversial subscription gaming purchase, noting the challenges faced about the service internally: "Game Pass, a Netflix-style monthly gaming service, helped Xbox build a subscription business. But it also led to a cannibalization of sales for the company’s higher-priced first-party game titles, especially during the critical launch period. And competing internal metrics within different teams — such as subscription revenue versus store revenue — exacerbated the problem, said former employees." Fortune's piece also addresses a next-gen Xbox handheld as well as the next-gen Project Helix console, suggesting that, as rumored, it won't be cheap — unless Microsoft chooses to subsidize any of the cost. A Game Pass revamp would be only the latest in a series of bold moves by Sharma, who has been on the job barely six months and has already cut the price of Game Pass Ultimate, signed Hideo Kojima's next-gen Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor project Physint , started two new verticals within Xbox, and handed development of Halo to Activision , to name a few. She's even found time to personally respond to customer support tickets and check out the latest build of The Elder Scrolls 6.

items.title: Umamusume Fans Distraught After Los Angeles Concerts Canceled Due to Visa Issues
items.excerpt: Umamusume concerts in Los Angeles have been canceled after workers could not get their visas approved in time for the event, leaving American fans distraught.
items.content_text: Two Umamusume concerts in Los Angeles have been canceled after workers could not get their visas approved in time for the event, leaving American fans distraught. On October 18, the official Umamusume: Pretty Derby Twitter/X account announced that staffers working the shows — scheduled for October 22 and 23 — were having difficulties securing their travel visas. At the time, it did not cancel the events, but warned concertgoers that this may impact the festivities. The possibility that these concerts would be canceled sparked concern among the game’s fanbase, with many joking (or perhaps being fully serious) that this event might politically “radicalize” them, given the extremely long wait times for visas in the United States right now. The next day, Cygames confirmed that the Los Angeles concerts had been officially canceled, offering refunds to fans who’d purchased both on-site viewing tickets and streaming tickets to watch the show remotely. Responses to fans who made travel plans are also in progress, though Cygames admitted that this may take “some time.” “Although we have coordinated repeatedly with all parties concerned and explored every possible option in our efforts to make this event happen, we were unable to obtain the necessary visas for entry into the US, so we have come to the painful conclusion that holding the concerts is no longer possible,” the post reads. “Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this causes to all the Trainers who were eagerly looking forward to the concerts, as well as to the Umamusume cast, partner company staff, and everyone involved who put tremendous effort into making this event happen.” It is with heavy hearts that we must announce the cancellation of the Umamusume: Pretty Derby – 7th EVENT: THE STAGE in LOS ANGELES concerts planned for Oct 22–23, 2026. Although we have coordinated repeatedly with all parties concerned and explored every possible option in our efforts to make this event happen, we were unable to obtain the necessary visas for entry into the US, so we have come to the painful conclusion that holding the concerts is no longer possible. To all the Trainers who were eagerly looking forward to the show, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and concern this causes, and for announcing this so close to the event date. Due to this cancellation, we will process refunds for the following: ・On-site viewing tickets ・Streaming tickets In addition, we are looking into possible responses to Trainers who were planning to attend the concert in person. This will take some time, so we ask for your patience. Details will be announced on the 7th EVENT WORLD TOUR official website. Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this causes to all the Trainers who were eagerly looking forward to the concerts, as well as to the Umamusume cast, partner company staff, and everyone involved who put tremendous effort into making this event happen. Please see the link below for the official notice: https://t.co/lrZyCDHwhh — Umamusume: Pretty Derby (@umamusume_eng) October 20, 2026 It’s safe to say that Umamusume fans in the States are completely beside themselves over this news, with many who’d made travel arrangements feeling especially burnt by the situation — not at Cygames, but with the political issues that are making visa acquisitions especially arduous. “I'm so sorry that this happened. I was excited to have a mini-concert at home and had many friends and acquaintances who were excited to go. I wish things could have worked out,” one fan replied . “Thank you so very much for trying, it's heart-breaking but we know you tried until the very end,” another wrote . “This is not the America I wanted to live in,” another said , while yet another joked that the country is currently experiencing an “anti-Uma administration.” Knowing the power of the Umamusume fanbase, some netizens are genuinely convinced that this incident could result in real political activism; after all, these fans have made several real-world impacts over the years, with the community previously banding together to save a sick racehorse from a slaughterhouse , raising over $600,000 to rebuild stables for the horse Meisho Doto, and even inspiring a disabled fan to perform onstage for the very first time. Umamusume concerts aren’t the only events getting impacted by long visa wait times; several other shows have also fallen victim to this issue, with the likes of Shinee’s Taemin being forced to cancel his entire North American tour due to being unable to secure visas for its staff and key personnel.

items.title: AMD FSR 4.1 Is Finally Coming to Xbox Series X, Rivaling PS5's QSSR
items.excerpt: AMD FSR 4.1 has been a massive improvement for Team Red's AI upscaling tech, but it was previously only available on Radeon 7000 and 9000 graphics cards. But today, AMD has announced that the technology will now be coming to more devices, like the Xbox Series X.
items.content_text: AMD FSR 4.1 has been a massive improvement for Team Red's AI upscaling tech, but it was previously only available on Radeon 7000 and 9000 graphics cards. But today, AMD has announced that the technology will now be coming to more devices like the Xbox Series X. Just like DLSS, FSR 4.1 uses AI to take a lower resolution input image and upscale it back up to native resolution, but because it's more computationally expensive than FSR 3, support for lower-powered hardware has been slow. However, thanks to the ongoing partnership with Sony (dubbed Project Amethyst), AMD has been making huge strides to make it run better on weaker devices. AMD announced the widened support in a video , and will bring the upscaling tech to RDNA 2 graphics cards like the 6800 XT , along with Z2-powered handhelds like the Xbox Ally X20 . What stopped AMD from bringing this model to these older and less-powerful chips was that it was harder to run, which eliminated some of the benefit of even using upscaling. But, according to AMD SVP of Gaming and Graphics Jack Huynh, AMD was able to trim down the model to make it efficient on less powerful hardware that might not have the same suite of AI accelerators that RDNA 4 graphics cards do. This comes just a couple weeks after AMD and Sony did the same exact thing with PSSR 2 , trimming it down to a new model, dubbed QSSR , for the base PS5. QSSR does offer much better upscaling than FSR 2-based solution the PS5 had before, so I can only imagine this slimmer FSR 4.1 will have a similar effect for the Xbox Ally X. But more importantly, this update will also allow FSR 4.1 to come to the Xbox Series X for the first time. The new upscaling model isn't out yet on Xbox, but AMD says it is 'coming soon,' although it's not clear what 'soon' means there. Hopefully, Microsoft is able to get it into a patch before Grand Theft Auto 6 launches next month. After all, there have been plenty of concerns that Rockstar's next crime epic is going to be extremely hard to run for the base consoles , and a better upscaler just means better performance and improved image quality. But even if this FSR 4.1 update misses GTA's launch date, Xbox is going to continue working with AMD to bring upscaling to its consoles. In the same video Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet confirmed that AMD's next-generation FSR 'Diamond' would be coming to Project Helix. And now that Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has confirmed that Helix would be a whole 'family of devices,' I hope that this fancy new upscaling finds its way to all of them, no matter how powerful they are.

items.title: Xbox's Next Console May Reportedly Cost As Much as $1,800, New Handheld Rumored to Launch Next Year Before Helix
items.excerpt: A new report claims that Xbox expects its next-generation console to cost as much as $1,800 and is currently targeting a 2028 release.
items.content_text: A new report claims that Xbox expects its next-generation console to cost as much as $1,800 and is currently targeting a 2028 release. A new article from Fortune claims that Microsoft has internally projected that its next Xbox console, codenamed Project Helix, will cost consumers between $1,200 - $1,800. The article notes that Microsoft could choose to subsidize those costs to come in at a lower price point, but unless the tech giant is will to take major losses on the console that would go beyond normal standards, it seems likely that the machine will still cost over $1,000. Of course, maybe a miracle could happen and the costs for the parts could lower in the coming years, but the odds of that seem excessively low. It's not uncommon for platform holders to take a loss on hardware, as the real money is made on games and subscriptions. However, Xbox doesn't have the same market share that it had 15 years ago. It is harder to justify big gambles, but the cost of the hardware itself may be a gamble which puts Microsoft between a rock and a hard place. Fortune noted that Microsoft has also moved up engineering deadlines on Project Helix, instructing the team to move faster on building the hardware. As a result, Microsoft has also employed the use of AI to improve the productivity. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma told the outlet that they won't use “AI for AI’s sake,” and are using it to solve engineering and performance problems. Fortune also revealed that Xbox is also planning to release a handheld by holiday 2027, though it's unclear how linked this will be to Project Helix. Sharma has stated before that Helix is a "family" of devices , so this handheld could be the first step. While some initially thought that may mean this generation will have another Xbox Series X and S situation, with one console that is more entry level and another that is for more hardcore players, it may be a bit different. Instead of a weaker console, Xbox may leverage less power inside of a handheld, which may be more appealing and sensible. Xbox previously stated we would hear more about Project Helix by the end of year , so maybe we will learn more in November for the company's 25th anniversary. Ultimately, it sounds like the next console generation is going to look a lot different than previous ones. PlayStation is also rumored to have its own handheld companion in the works and reports suggest that Sony will likely have a costly console as well. A recent rumor suggested that PS6's RAM and storage would cost $680 alone , which is already more than any PlayStation console's launch price except for the PS5 Pro. With the additional required components, it's expected the PS6 will also brush up against, if not exceed the $1,000 price point. Ultimately, it seems like the age of the affordable console may be coming to an end, at least for now. Whether prices will ever come back down remains to be seen, but it doesn't seem like it will happen any time soon.

items.title: Last Call to Order the Pokémon 2026 Halloween Collection From Pokémon Center and Get It in Time for Halloween
items.excerpt: The Pokémon Center dropped its Halloween Collection for 2026, with new apparel and decor featuring Gengar, Mimikyu, Umbreon, and... Golett?
items.content_text: The Pokémon Center dropped its Halloween Collection for 2026, and today (October 20) is the last day to order stuff to ensure your merch arrives by October 31. The latest releases include a mix of spooky-themed decorations, apparel, and kitchenware featuring fan-favorite Pokémon. The company is also seemingly getting ahead of the winter holiday season with new ornaments and snow globes. Pok é mon Center's 2026 Halloween Collection The Pokémon Company has been celebrating the franchise’s 30th anniversary with a ridiculous amount of drops and announcements . This is one collection I always look forward to, however, because I’m a huge fan of the Ghost types that are typically featured. It shouldn't come as any surprise that the Poké-star of this year’s drop is Gengar, who technically predates the Ghost type itself . That guy’s been getting a ridiculous amount of merch love recently. Other featured Pokémon include Mimikyu, Mewtwo, one of my all-time favorites, Misdreavus, and… Golett ? That one honestly caught me off guard. On the decor side, I'm a big fan of the Umbreon and Espeon statues. I want the ethereal Eevee-lution duo guarding my house (apartment, but let me pretend) at all times. These are the same "made to look like stone" style as the previously released Cubone and Mimikyu statues that have been out of stock all year. There’s a spread of more functional ‘pumpkin Pokémon’-themed items like tea-light holders and mugs, which I personally think are a bit jarring to look at. One thing that certainly isn't spooky is the Ditto candy holder. I, like presumably many people, recently rediscovered my adoration for Ditto through Pokémon Pokopia , and actually love how this thing is used to house tons of plushies in the promotional images . The new apparel generally falls into the ‘cozy’ category, with a mix of sweaters, pajamas, and even bath robes almost entirely in adult sizes. The knit Gengar cardigan is a personal highlight, with a darker spiral pattern that's making me want to kick off my annual rewatch of The Nightmare Before Christmas. Speaking of, the drop also includes a new batch of ornaments. I guess Halloween is close enough to the winter festivities. The collection varies widely in terms of pricing, with the ornaments being the cheapest at $16.99, followed by Halloween-themed Pokémon window clings for $19.99. The most expensive new release is the luxurious Gengar bath robe, listed at $69.99. You can see the full Halloween collection here , with all of the new additions already available to purchase. Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.
